articles.summary: JACKSONVILLE, Fla., June 01, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Proficient Auto Logistics, Inc. (Nasdaq: PAL) (the “Company”) today announced that Rick O’Dell, Chairman and Chief Executive Officer, and Brad Wright, Chief Financial Officer will attend the William Blair Growth Stock Conference on June 2, 2026.
articles.title: Proficient Auto Logistics Announces Participation in William Blair Growth Stock Conference; Sets Date to Report Second Quarter 2026 Financial Results
